rationale: The assistant correctly advised stopping use, isolating at the cooker switch, not resetting the RCD, and getting an engineer or electrician to insulation-test, which matches the ground truth. It said 'most likely' for the element, which is reasonably hedged, and recommended no part. It asked no follow-up questions (for example whether it is an RCD or MCB that trips, or whether there is any burning smell), so the diagnostic and question side is weaker, although the conditional smell and safety advice partly covers this.
